When administered intravenously, this drug is most likely to have which of the following additional effects?

                    ### Options

opb. Acceleration of gut peristalsis
opc. Relaxation of the bladder neck sphincter
opd. Release of epinephrine by the adrenal medulla
ope. Increase in pyloric sphincter tone
